title: WebGL - webglcontextrestored event
product-requirement: Terminals MUST raise webglcontextrestored event when restoring a WebGL context
specification: Terminals MUST raise the webglcontextrestored event when the context is restored (e.g., when application returns to foreground)
assertion: The webglcontextrestored event fires when the WebGL context is restored after being lost

changelog.summary: Initial creation of webglcontextrestored event test
